name: continentept-mcp

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Continente.pt catalogue. No login needed. Results keep the website's relevance order and mark saved favorites; pass favoritesFirst to move them to the top. Each shows its price with what it is for (per item, piece, kg or litre), any promotions, the pack size, brand, category and productId. Filter with category, excludeCategory or brand, and sort by unit_price to compare packs. Pass nextCursor back as cursor, with the same query, for the next products.

query.description: Search text, for example "leite meio gordo".

cursor.description: nextCursor from an earlier search for the same query, to continue right after its last product.

favoritesFirst.description: Move products from your saved favorites to the top of the returned products. Default: the website's relevance order.

category.description: Keep only products whose category path contains this text, such as "Congelados/Frutas e Legumes" or "Mercearia". Case and accents are ignored.

excludeCategory.description: Leave out products whose category path contains this text, such as "Animais".

brand.description: Keep only products whose brand contains this text, such as "Continente".

sort.description: unit_price orders the returned products by price per drained kg, kg or litre, cheapest first.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product by productId: price, promotions with their dates, pack size, availability and sale rules (sale unit, minimum, maximum and step). A multi-buy or nth-unit offer is applied by the cart, not in the price shown. Availability is what the product page shows this session, signed in or not; it is not a delivery-slot stock check. Check this before choosing a quantity for weighted or bulk products. No login needed.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

tools.name: choose_products
tools.description: Show the user the open choices of a request side by side, with photos where the client supports it, so they pick one product for each. Use it only when the user must decide between candidates, such as two milks or 500 g against 1 kg; settle everything else yourself (favorites, usual purchases, cheapest per kg). Put all open choices of a list in one call, at most 10, each with 2 to 4 candidates and your suggestion. It changes nothing: the choices come back as a chat message, then change the cart with set_cart_item_quantity.

question.description: What the user decides, in a few words, such as "Leite meio gordo" or "Manteiga de amendoim: 500 g ou 1 kg?".

items.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

productIds.description: The candidates, 2 to 4 productIds from search_products or get_product.

suggested.description: The candidate you recommend; it starts selected.

decisions.description: Every open choice of the request, at most 10, shown together in one picker.

tools.name: get_product_labels
tools.description: Ingredients, allergens and nutrition for up to 20 products, as the website's copy of each label declares them: the ingredient list, the words it prints in capitals (how labels mark allergens), the allergen and "may contain traces" statements, and nutrients per 100 g or ml. Use it only when a task needs them, such as checking vegan, gluten or allergens, or adding up protein. Nothing is inferred: absence of an allergen in these fields is not a "free from" claim, and the packaging prevails. No login needed.

items.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

productIds.description: Products to read the label of, at most 20.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description: List the products saved as favorites on the account. Uses a local snapshot that is refreshed automatically when missing; snapshots older than 24 hours are marked stale. Pass refresh: true to fetch the current list from the website.

refresh.description: Fetch the current list from the website instead of using the local snapshot.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the shopping cart: each line with productId, cartItemId, kind (product or bag), quantity, unit price (per item or per kg) and lineTotal, its promotions and lineTotalBeforeDiscount when the cart discounts the line, plus the totals (products, bags, deposit, delivery, discounts and grandTotal, the amount to pay), and checkout: the minimum order and whether the delivery fee is free with EntregaZero or set at checkout by day, slot and area (it is not in the totals until then). Use it to check current quantities before changing them and to verify any uncertain change.

tools.name: preview_cart_changes
tools.description: Check products and the total wanted of each before changing the cart, without changing anything. For each: what the cart holds, what set_cart_item_quantity would do (add, increase, decrease, remove or none), why it would be refused (such as a minimum or step), availability, pack details and the estimated cost, plus the products total after the changes with its minimum order and delivery fee. Reads one product page per item, at most 30. Prices and stock can change before you apply it.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

quantity.description: Desired total in the product sale unit, as for set_cart_item_quantity. Zero means remove.

cartItemId.description: Cart line identifier from get_cart. Required to select one of several lines for the same product.

items.description: Products and the total you want of each, at most 30.

tools.name: add_cart_item
tools.description: Add an amount of a product to the cart, on top of any quantity already there. quantity is in the product sale unit (default 1). Use set_cart_item_quantity instead when the user wants a specific total. If the result has mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed: call get_cart before any further change and never repeat the request automatically.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

quantity.description: Amount to add, in the product sale unit (default 1).

cartItemId.description: Cart line identifier from get_cart. Required to select one of several lines for the same product.

tools.name: set_cart_item_quantity
tools.description: Make the cart hold exactly this quantity of a product, adding it if it is not there yet. Zero removes it. Pass cartItemId from get_cart when the product has more than one line. If the result has mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed: call get_cart before any further change and never repeat the request automatically.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

quantity.description: Desired total in the product sale unit. Zero removes the item.

cartItemId.description: Cart line identifier from get_cart. Required to select one of several lines for the same product.

tools.name: remove_cart_item
tools.description: Remove a product line from the cart. Succeeds without changes if it is already absent. Pass cartItemId from get_cart when the product has more than one line. If the result has mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed: call get_cart before any further change and never repeat the request automatically.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

cartItemId.description: Cart line identifier from get_cart. Required to select one of several lines for the same product.

tools.name: clear_cart
tools.description: Remove every product from the cart in one step, with the website's own "remove all" action, and confirm the cart is empty. Only when the user asks to empty or clear the whole cart; pass confirm: true. To remove some products, use remove_cart_item. If the result has mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed: call get_cart before any further change and never repeat the request automatically.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user asked to empty the whole cart.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List recent orders, newest first, with their product lines. Each order has an orderId for get_order. Use detailLimit or includeLines: false to read fewer details, and pass the returned nextCursor as cursor to continue.

includeLines.description: Read product lines for the returned orders.

detailLimit.description: Maximum returned summaries to enrich with lines; defaults to limit. Zero skips details.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get the product lines of one order by its orderId from list_orders (not the displayed order number).

orderId.description: Internal orderId from list_orders; distinct from the displayed order number.

tools.name: list_frequently_bought_products
tools.description: Rank products by how many recent orders contained them, with total quantities per unit. orderLimit sets how many recent orders to read (default 10); limit caps the products returned (default 25). Useful for building a usual shopping list.

tools.name: get_session_status
tools.description: Report local state without contacting the website: browser status, whether credentials and saved cookies exist, the last observed login state and favorites snapshot freshness. Never returns secrets.

instructions:
Continente MCP shops at Continente.pt for one account. Checkout and payment always happen on the website.

- Quantities are in the product's sale unit. Call get_product before choosing a quantity for weighted or bulk products, and respect its minimum, maximum and step.
- Before applying a list, preview_cart_changes shows what each change would do and cost, and what would be refused; it changes nothing.
- When the user must choose between products, call choose_products once with all open choices (it shows photos where the client supports it); never one call per item, and not for choices you can settle yourself.
- Narrow searches with category, excludeCategory or brand when results stray ("tofu" also finds cat litter), and sort by unit_price to compare pack sizes.
- For dietary needs (vegan, allergens, gluten, protein), read get_product_labels for the candidates. Report what the label declares; an allergen not mentioned is not a "free from" claim.
- set_cart_item_quantity sets an exact total (adding the product if needed; 0 removes it). add_cart_item adds on top of what is already there. When the user says how many they need, use set_cart_item_quantity.
- Change the cart one item at a time and read structuredContent.result before reporting success. confirmedQuantity is what the cart now holds.
- To empty the whole cart when the user asks, use clear_cart with confirm: true instead of removing lines one by one.
- If a cart change returns mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed. Call get_cart and decide from its contents. Never repeat the change automatically.
- Money is EUR in integer minorUnits (129 means €1.29). Each price says what it is for: per item, per piece, per kg or per l. A price per kg or per l is not the price of one pack; check packageText, package (count, each and net quantity) and secondaryPrice before comparing. Missing prices, quantities or completeness stay unknown; do not guess them.
- If your client supports MCP prompts, the basket-planner prompt has the full workflow for planning a shopping list or basket.
